Package software.amazon.smithy.model.traits

Class AbstractResourceLifecycleTrait<R extends ResourceBinding>

java.lang.Object
software.amazon.smithy.model.traits.AbstractTrait
software.amazon.smithy.model.traits.AbstractResourceLifecycleTrait<R>
Type Parameters:
R - The concrete binding type held by the trait. Create, put, read, and update use ResourceLifecycleBinding; delete uses ResourceDeletionBinding, which has no properties.
All Implemented Interfaces:
FromSourceLocation, ToNode, ToShapeId, Trait
Direct Known Subclasses:
CreatesResourcesTrait, DeletesResourcesTrait, PutsResourcesTrait, ReadsResourcesTrait, UpdatesResourcesTrait
public abstract class AbstractResourceLifecycleTrait<R extends ResourceBinding> extends AbstractTrait
Contains abstract functionality shared by the resource lifecycle traits (@createsResources, @deletesResources, @putsResources, @readsResources, and @updatesResources), each of which is a list of ResourceBinding.
